capacity_gross_kwh.notes: Estimated: the GTS shares the 2025 refresh 105 kWh pack with the rest of the range; no opened page states the GTS pack. 105 kWh gross (Porsche US: Performance Battery Plus 105 kWh gross). Pack from trim: Turbo/Turbo S/Cross Turismo/Turbo GT 105 kWh per InsideEVs; GTS 105 kWh per press (Sport Turismo GTS listing), not on a Porsche page I opened.

capacity_usable_kwh.notes: Estimated: the GTS shares the 2025 refresh 105 kWh pack with the rest of the range; no opened page states the GTS pack. 97 kWh usable (InsideEVs table; Wikipedia 82.3 / 97 net).

dc_max_kw.notes: Estimated: the GTS shares the 2025 refresh 105 kWh pack with the rest of the range; no opened page states the GTS pack. Up to 320 kW (Porsche US: 320 kW at 800 V).

published_10_80_min.notes: Estimated: the GTS shares the 2025 refresh 105 kWh pack with the rest of the range; no opened page states the GTS pack. Porsche: 18 minutes 10-80% under ideal conditions.

ac_max_kw.notes: Estimated: the GTS shares the 2025 refresh 105 kWh pack with the rest of the range; no opened page states the GTS pack. InsideEVs 2025 table: on-board charger 9.6 kW (US). Porsche's global release says 11 kW standard (Europe); 19.2 kW optional in North America. Canada assumed equal to the US.
